description: This file defines the ThreadPool class and related nested classes and interfaces for managing a thread pool, including job scheduling, execution, and monitoring within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes definitions for jobs, schedulers, dispatchers, and minions, as well as thread management and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of threads, scheduling and executing jobs, with support for monitoring and callbacks.

classes.name: ThreadPool::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to notify when the thread pool is idle.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IJob
classes.description: Interface representing a job that can be resubmitted.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IScheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling jobs at specific times.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for initializing, deinitializing, and dispatching jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Metadata
classes.description: Structure holding metadata about worker threads.

classes.name: ThreadPool::DispatchedJobMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for dispatched jobs, used in warning reporting and monitoring.

classes.name: ThreadPool::JobType
classes.description: Template class representing a job with state management and resubmission capabilities.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Minion
classes.description: Represents a worker entity that processes jobs from the queue.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Executor
classes.description: Thread class that runs a Minion to process jobs.

methods.name: Resubmit
methods.description: Resubmits a job for execution, possibly after a delay.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Callback invoked when the thread pool is idle.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of a worker.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the queue.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Attempts to revoke a job from the queue or execution.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending jobs.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of worker threads.

methods.name: Snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current worker thread states and queued jobs.

methods.name: RevokeRequired
methods.description: Checks if a job needs to be revoked.

methods.name: Closure
methods.description: Handles rescheduling or immediate posting of jobs.
